name: Temple of Zin-Malor
summary: Spitelash naga hold the Temple of Zin-Malor in the Ruins of Eldarath. Warlord Krellian commands them from this ancient night elven sanctuary in Azshara.

sections.title: Echoes of the Moon
sections.body: Before the Great Sundering, the Temple of Zin-Malor rang with worship of Elune. Its graceful stonework recalls the nearby Temple of Arkkoran and the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, both built in the old night elven style. Now the marble lies weathered and broken. Spitelash naga have claimed the holy grounds and made them a stronghold for their forces.

sections.title: The Stolen Crystal
sections.body: The Crystal of Zin-Malor once rested in the temple. Long ago, it was carried away to Kel'Theril in Winterspring.

faq.q: Who controls the Temple of Zin-Malor today?
aliases: who is the boss in zin malor
faq.answer: Spitelash naga occupy the Temple of Zin-Malor today. Their regional leader, Warlord Krellian, lives within its walls.

faq.q: What was the temple used for originally?
faq.answer: Ancient night elves built the temple before the Great Sundering as a sacred place to worship Elune, the moon goddess.

faq.q: Why does it look so much like the temple in Darnassus?
faq.answer: The Temple of Zin-Malor and the nearby Temple of Arkkoran share the old night elven style seen in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: What is the Crystal of Zin-Malor?
aliases: where is the crystal of zin malor
faq.answer: The Crystal of Zin-Malor is an ancient magical relic that once rested in the temple. Long ago, residents of Kel'Theril carried it away to Winterspring.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the Highborne era in Zin-Malor's ruins and the naga's corruption of ground once sacred to Elune.
As a priest, you can find Elune's worship in these stones and sanctuary layouts like those still kept by the sisterhoods in Darnassus.
